title: Juicy
headline: Biggie wanted 'Machine Gun Funk' as his first single
caption:
The Notorious B.I.G.'s "Juicy" was sampled directly from the "Fruity Instrumental" mix of Mtume's 1983 song "Juicy Fruit".

Smoother was what Sean Combs wanted for the release. Biggie and Easy Mo Bee had wanted "Machine Gun Funk" out first for its "funky, upbeat" sound. "Juicy" became the lead single instead, produced by Poke of Trackmasters with Combs, and it has an alternative chorus sung by Total, the Bad Boy girl group, and Combs himself.
